name: Jest of the Abandoned Guard Tower
body:
School: enchantment (compulsion) [mind-affecting]; Level: jester 2

CASTING

Casting Time: 1 standard action

EFFECT

Range: Close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)

Target: One creature

Duration: 1 round

Saving Throw: Will negates; see text; Spell Resistance: yes

DESCRIPTION

The target takes a -3 penalty to attack rolls until the end of your next turn. If you or an ally attacks the target, this effect ends.
